summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Fidelity Fundamental Global ex-U.S. ETF (FFGX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund seeks to achieve long-term capital growth through an actively managed portfolio of global ex-US equity securities selected based on fundamental factors. The fund includes issuers of any market capitalization. FFGX was launched on Nov 19, 2024 and is issued by Fidelity.

holdings.infoBox: FFGX is an equity ETF with a total of 185 individual holdings. The top holdings are Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company stock at 7.86%, Samsung Electronics at 3.52%, ASML Holding at 3.03%, SK hynix at 2.43%, and Tencent Holdings at 1.81%.
